Successfully configured Chrome to automatically delete browsing data when closing the browser.

**Setting Applied:** On-device site data → Default behaviour → "Delete data sites that have been saved to your device when you close all windows"

**What this does:**
- Automatically clears cookies, site data, and browsing data when all Chrome windows are closed
- Sites will work normally during browsing sessions
- You will be signed out of most websites when you close Chrome (except Google Account if you're signed in)
- This setting applies to all sites by default

The configuration is now active and will take effect the next time you close all Chrome windows.
